info.title: CivicPulse API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the CivicPulse Express API. Auth cookies are HTTP-only; unsafe cookie-bearing requests additionally require a matching Origin or Referer. The API prefix is configurable through API_PREFIX, defaulting to /api.
